title: Texture index of a unit (ob.texture-index/1.0)
description: textures.md section 3.1: the unit's texture sets and texture-animation files, in search order. Cross-file rules (file presence, unique ids, where `section` is required or refused: TEX.1; unlisted files: TEX.2; `op = "add"` only in mod packs: TEX.3) are checked by readers.

set.description: Texture sets in search order. Each names <id>.toml and the folder <id>/ next to this file.

anims.description: Texture-animation files, each <id>.anims.toml next to this file, in the order their records apply.

id.description: A set or animation-file id: also its file name stem.

group.description: The load group: what the engine loads together (an original file or a stream section).

section.description: The stream section whose load brings this entry in (world.md). Required for the base set's entries in a world/<REGION> index, optional for a mod pack's there, refused in every other index (TEX.1).
